slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental summary of the October 2016 APAI-CRVS monitoring round, reported as counts of countries. Burundi is named only in the annex: scored 50-64% on legal framework and 65-79% on infrastructure and resources, and the footnotes say Burundi lacks data on digitization, on planning and coordination, on the registration process, on vital statistics and on the overall score. Nothing is stated about how Burundi's offices record events.
